market_overview: Across the evidence packet, bullish signals dominate in AI & Technology, Gold, Bitcoin and Oil, while interest rates, U.S. equities, inflation and the dollar sit at mixed/neutral positions. Consensus is mixed on rates, equities, inflation and the dollar, reflecting divergent views on central‑bank policy and geopolitical risk. Oil and AI show the strongest bullish bias with high confidence, whereas Bitcoin’s mixed vote and recent bearish pattern temper its bullish consensus. Market sentiment overall is neutral, with the PSI at 52 and no clear directional drift across major asset classes.
